a series of montmorilonite-(Ce or zirconium) phosphate crosslinked materials has been prepared by reaction of a cation exchanged montomorillonite with phosphoric acid.
the synthesis and characterization of montmornilonite-(Ce or Zn) phosphate crosslinked compound has been carried out.
a series of cerium or zircunium phosphate crosslinked compounds have been synthesized by reaction between montmorillonite and phosphoric acid under controlled conditions.

the preparation of materials with a new structure and with a potential use as catalysts or catalyst supports.
the preparation of new materials that can be used as catalysts, ion exchangers, adsorbents, and in the preparation of nanocomposites.
the synthesis of new materials based on montmorillonite and metal phosphate.

the metal(IV)-phosphate crosslinked montmorillinites are a new class of materials with a high potential for use in catalysis and in environmental applications.
these materials are not simple mixtures, but are new hybrid inorganic-organic materials with interesting properties.
the montmorillonite(IV) phosphate compounds obtained are not true clays.
